svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 07 · Riverside · 08/12 Santa Ana Winds (Common)
svg.desc: The dry wind comes down off the passes. The sky goes sharp blue and every palm leans one way. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
